senses.gloss:
√tṛ (tárati, -te; tiráti, -te; tatā́ra, terús
[794e]; átārīt; tariṣyáti, -te; tīrṇá; tártum;
tīrtvā́; -tī́rya; tāráyati).
 —1. cross
over (a water, the sky);
 —2. get across or
to the end; get through, escape; survive.
[cf. τέρμων, Lat. terminus, ‘boundary’:
see √trā and tiras: for treatment of root-vowel,
 see 242.]
+ ava, descend, esp. from heaven to
earth; come down, esp. of divine beings
who become incarnate as men; alight; betake
one's self to; caus. take down or off.
+ ud, come up out of the water.
+ abhy-ud, come out of the water unto,
cross the water unto, 89^4.
+ pra, take to the water; start on.
+ vi, cross through; traverse.
